remarks: Adorable and Affordable! Don't miss this rare opportunity to own in Stamford's most sought-after condominium complex, The Chesterfield, where convenience meets luxury! As you enter this move-in-ready, first-floor unit, you'll be greeted by a fabulous open floor plan. The bright living room, featuring beautiful hardwood floors, seamlessly connects to the kitchen and bedroom.The kitchen boasts stylish white cabinetry, sleek granite countertops, and the convenience of in-unit laundry. The generously sized bedroom offers ample closet space, sliding doors to your private deck, and easy access to a full bathroom. Enjoy a maintenance-free lifestyle in this desirable complex, complete with 24-hour security, two inviting pools and a community room-all within walking distance of shopping and downtown Stamford. It truly doesn't get better than this! Make your home ownership dreams a reality. Schedule your showing today and discover what makes this community so special!
